actions.eval: (() => { const d = document.querySelector('[role=dialog]'); return d ? { dialog: d.getAttribute('aria-label'), sections: [...d.querySelectorAll('section')].map(s => s.innerText.split('\n')[0].trim()) } : 'no dialog' })()

(() => { const a = [...document.querySelectorAll('section')].find(x => x.innerText.startsWith('Account')); if (!a) return 'no Account section'; a.scrollIntoView({ block: 'start' }); return { account: a.innerText, dataAccount: document.querySelector('[data-account]') !== null, inputs: [...a.querySelectorAll('input')].map(i => i.type + ':' + (i.closest('label')?.innerText ?? '')), buttons: [...a.querySelectorAll('button')].map(b => b.innerText.trim()) } })()

(() => { const p = document.querySelector('[data-plans]') ?? [...document.querySelectorAll('section')].find(x => x.innerText.startsWith('Plan')); return p ? { plan: p.innerText, plans: document.querySelectorAll('[data-plan]').length, prices: /\$|€|£|per month|per year|\/mo/.test(p.innerText) } : 'no Plan section' })()

(() => { const s = [...document.querySelectorAll('section')].find(x => x.innerText.startsWith('Model')); if (!s) return 'no Model section'; s.scrollIntoView({ block: 'start' }); return { model: s.innerText, allowanceChip: [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].some(b => b.innerText.trim() === 'Free allowance'), freeAllowanceText: /Free allowance/.test(document.body.innerText) } })()

(() => { const s = [...document.querySelectorAll('section')].find(x => x.innerText.startsWith('Model')); return s ? s.innerText : 'no Model section' })()
